briefing: Treasure grew the most: its total value went from $21.1M to $38.6M, up 82.6% in 24 hours.
Across the 306 Binance coins worth between $15M and $2B, 271 grew and 35 shrank — a strong day.
OpenLedger's market cap jumped 379.8%, but its price moved only 3.4% — more coins are now counted in circulation, so the jump didn't come from buyers. We tag these “New supply”.
